test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Invested.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given passage the correct option to be filled in the blank is Invested.
 
• Invested: To invest time, money, effort, etc. in anything in order to gain a benefit or profit.
 
 
• Example: *He has invested his money in the property market.*
 
 
 
• *​​*Therefore the correct option is Invested.

​The complete sentence is: **Many nobles and businessmen invested their wealth in building bridges and tunnels.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Donated** refers to helping a person or group by giving money or goods.
 
• **Supported** refers to praising someone or something because you want them to be successful.
 
• **Promoted** refers to the act of persuading someone to like, support, utilise, or purchase something.
